question: Analyze sales performance. Calculate total revenue, identify the top five products by revenue, compare monthly revenue, detect missing values, and recommend three data-backed actions.

plan.goal: Analyze sales performance: calculate total revenue, identify the top five products by revenue, compare monthly revenue, and detect missing values.

steps.description: Create a revenue column as quantity times unit_price and compute total revenue.
Group by product, sum revenue, and select the top five products.
Parse order_date, group by month, sum revenue, and sort chronologically.
Count missing values per column and total missing cells on the original dataset.

assumptions: Revenue equals quantity multiplied by unit_price; rows with missing quantity or unit_price produce a missing revenue that pandas skips when summing, so they add nothing to revenue.
Missing values are measured on the original dataset before the revenue column is added, so the revenue column's NaNs are not counted as missing cells.
Duplicate rows (13) are retained in calculations because the question does not ask to remove them.

code:
data = df.assign(revenue=df["quantity"] * df["unit_price"])
total_revenue = data["revenue"].sum()
emit_metric("Total revenue", total_revenue, check={"op": "sum", "columns": ["quantity", "unit_price"]})
top_products = (
    data.groupby("product", as_index=False)["revenue"]
    .sum()
    .sort_values("revenue", ascending=False)
    .head(5)
    .reset_index(drop=True)
)
emit_table("Top five products by revenue", top_products, check={"op": "sum", "columns": ["quantity", "unit_price"], "group_by": "product", "key_column": "product", "value_column": "revenue"})
emit_chart("Top five products by revenue", "bar", top_products, x="product", y="revenue", title="Top five products by revenue")
dated = data.assign(order_date=pd.to_datetime(data["order_date"], errors="coerce"))
dated = dated.assign(month=dated["order_date"].dt.to_period("M").astype(str))
monthly = (
    dated.groupby("month", as_index=False)["revenue"]
    .sum()
    .sort_values("month")
    .reset_index(drop=True)
)
emit_table("Monthly revenue", monthly, check={"op": "sum", "columns": ["quantity", "unit_price"], "group_by": "order_date", "key_column": "month", "value_column": "revenue", "time_grain": "month"})
emit_chart("Monthly revenue", "line", monthly, x="month", y="revenue", title="Monthly revenue")
missing_per_column = df.isna().sum().reset_index()
missing_per_column.columns = ["column", "missing_count"]
missing_per_column = missing_per_column.sort_values("missing_count", ascending=False).reset_index(drop=True)
emit_table("Missing values by column", missing_per_column)
total_missing = int(df.isna().sum().sum())
emit_metric("Total missing cells", total_missing, check={"op": "count_missing"})
